content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: billing-api
  namespace: production
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: billing-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: billing-api
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: billing-api
        image: registry.internal.net/billing:v2.1.0
        securityContext:
          privileged: true

FROM node:latest
WORKDIR /usr/src/app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

name: CI Pipeline
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout Code
      uses: actions/checkout@main
    - name: Run Test Suite
      run: npm test
